_: Hop cases both engines run: tests/test_hop.py and tests/js/hop_engine.test.js. A move names the cell stepped onto (a-x, reading order); final.pos is the landing (a stump's twin, the cell past a rug), which may not be that cell. expect is replay()'s answer; final.sunk lists the sunk cells. Each case's prefixes are also checked against a step-by-step apply (undo is a replay of the prefix). bad_boards are board replies both engines refuse (Board.from_dict raises ValueError; HATCH_HOP.valid is false).
